name: BAW 871 鸟击 左风挡裂 APU

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 871, from Beijing to London, you are at stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 BAW 871，从北京飞往伦敦，停在 215 机位，请求飞往伦敦的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, BAW 871, stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，BAW 871，215 机位，请求飞往伦敦的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK-05D departure, initial climb 9800 meters on 1023, cruising level 10400 meters, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，按计划航路放行至伦敦，执行 VYK-05D 离场，1023 修压上初始爬升 9800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 4523。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK-05D departure, initial climb 9800m on 1023, cruising level 10400m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至伦敦，执行 VYK-05D 离场，1023 修压上初始爬升 9800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 4523，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已准备好，联系地面请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW 871, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，BAW 871，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，可以推出开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，机头朝西，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: You noticed the tug is not in position yet, ask Ground control for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你注意到拖车尚未就位，向地面管制请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW 871, request a tug.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 871, roger, the tug on the way.
B: While taxiing, you notices the wind sock shows a strong tail wind, contact Ground to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 871，收到，拖车正在过来。
B：滑行时你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系地面核实风况。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW 871, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，BAW 871，请求风况检查。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，地面风 220 度，8 米/秒。

cards.audioText: B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to Runway 22 and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台请求改用跑道 22，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW 871, the tailwind exceeds takeoff limit, request change to Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，BAW 871，顺风超过起飞限制，请求改用跑道 22。

cards.audioText: B: After airborne, you fly into a flock of birds, the left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing. This is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞后你飞入鸟群，左风挡裂纹，请求放油并返场着陆。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, BAW 871, we encountered bird strike and our left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，BAW 871，我们遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹，请求放油并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, roger your PAN, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO030 radial inbound, climb to 3300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，收到 PAN，右转航向 240，切入 LKO030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radio inbound, climb to 3300m, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 LKO 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, after LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告。
cards.referenceText: After LKO, turn right heading 220, maintaining 3300m, report over LKO, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: Now you finished fuel dumping, ask for radar vectors to Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW 871, fuel dump completed, request radar vector to Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW 871，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100 meters, QNH 1015, expect Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，右转直飞 DA，下降至 2100 米，QNH 1015，预计跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH 1015, expect Runway 22, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，下降至 2100 米，QNH 1015，预计跑道 22，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: Your APU has failed, tell this situation to Beijing Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的 APU 失效，向北京塔台报告并请求地面电源车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW 871, request ground power unit due APU failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，BAW 871，因 APU 故障，请求地面电源车。
